business.name: GoCaters
business.hypothesis: Quote requests may require manual qualification by event date, location, guest count, menu, dietary needs, staffing, and equipment.

analysis.problem_hypothesis: Quote requests may require manual qualification by event date, location, guest count, menu, dietary needs, staffing, and equipment. This is a hypothesis to validate with the business.
analysis.solution: An AI-assisted enquiry qualification workflow that extracts the request type, location, urgency, and missing fields, then produces a structured lead and draft follow-up.
analysis.inputs: Public website enquiry or booking text, customer name and contact details, requested service, location, and preferred date or slot.
analysis.processing: Validate required fields, classify intent and urgency, extract service and location, detect missing information, and route the enquiry for follow-up.
analysis.outputs: A structured lead record, priority score, missing-information checklist, routing suggestion, and draft response for review.
analysis.business_value: Less manual triage, faster follow-up, more consistent records, and fewer incomplete bookings.
analysis.model_quality_note: qwen3:4b omitted required fields; the evidence-based baseline was used.
